verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. API credentials (client id/secret, connection key) are provisioned manually by email, with no mention of scopes or permission levels. The MCP "write access turned on (Beta)" toggle is an adjacent read/write control on the assistant connection, not a way to issue scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
